interpretation: Inquiry works in both directions. Connection setup currently fails in both directions with this single host, after initially working. Persistence across a phone reboot points at host-side state (stack or adapter after repeated pair/remove cycles, or the host's own combo radio), but phone-side causes are not excluded. An independent Bluetooth peer is required to separate them. Iris rails L16/L24 switch off with the WLAN radio off (observed); the effect of that on Bluetooth is unproven.
stock_reference: Stock WCNSS_qcom_cfg.ini sets no BTC overrides, so firmware defaults from WCNSS_cfg.dat (extracted privately) applied; wcn36xx sends its own BTC CFG table. Comparing the two is the next step.

iris_rails_by_wlan_state.note: PMIC SPMI readback; Linux drops its Iris votes after WCNSS handover (by design), so the RF supplies follow the Pronto firmware's WLAN-side votes

A clean-boot 2.4 GHz baseline, a host-first 5 GHz run and a WLAN-idle run all fail the same way. A plain unpaired phone-to-host l2ping, which passed 10/10 in five early runs, now fails even after a clean phone reboot.
